name: Canali
why: Italian suits and tailoring, family-owned, with wide distribution through American specialty stores.
origin: Founded in 1934 by the brothers Giovanni and Giacomo Canali.

onething.n: verified — the house's own Kei line page, US site. Unlined and without internal structure, so the jacket follows the body instead of holding a shape against it. Named by the London shop floor when asked what Canali is known for, and retailers describe Kei as the signature block rather than a seasonal model

notes.ital: Family-run in Brianza since 1934, which puts it in the second rank of Italian tailoring by fame and the first by consistency. The register is Milanese: structured, sober, unshowy.

notes.craft: Canali says 70% of its production is in its own Italian workshops, with five production centres and over 1,400 staff, and 30% is made by Italian third parties. Every PDP sampled says Made in Italy, but no PDP or company page names a factory town or a cloth mill. So the house has real owned making that does not cover the whole range, and it is described rather than placed: a 4. [ruled by Sebastian 4 Oct 2026]

cities: 4 stores — Beverly Hills, Elmont, Las Vegas, New York · department stores and independent menswear shops, and its own site

craft_evidence.owned_d: Brand states owned making but names no place: made-in-italy page: '70% of our production takes place in our own workshops in Italy, and the remaining 30% entrusted to carefully monitored Italian third-party suppliers'; 'a short, verticalized, and integrated supply chain'. About-us page: 'five production centers strategically located in Italy', 'over 1400 employees'. Neither page names the towns; company-data page gives only the registered office (Via Lombardia 17/19, Sovico MB) and parent Canali Holding SpA. Rated unclear only because no production site is named; the 70% figure is specific.
craft_evidence.countries: Italy 5/5 (sample of 5 PDPs: suit, dress shirt, knit crew neck, car coat, denim trousers); a 6th PDP (oxford shoe) returned no readable content.
